## Context / Problem

`src/rebar/llm/plan_review/passes.py:562-593::pass4_coach` is legacy bespoke coaching after the workflow cutover; its direct behavioral callers are in `tests/unit/test_plan_review.py:711-877`. Its string-literal ownership inventory is also live: `tests/unit/test_subcall_class_selection.py:324,614,648-650` contains a `pass4_coach` key in `_UNFOLLOWABLE`, a `pass4_coach` RunRequest row in `_EXPECTED_RUN_REQUEST_SITES`, and the AST-derived RunRequest count/assertion. `src/rebar/llm/workflow/executor.py:335-352::_guard_passes` is only directly exercised by `tests/unit/workflow/test_prior_art_hardening.py:64-65`; the v2 runtime uses `workflow/interpreter.py:284-305::_guard_scoped`.

## Approach

First migrate the `pass4_coach` behavioral tests and every ownership-inventory string to the live workflow/shared `review_kernel.coach` owner. Delete the `pass4_coach` entry from `_UNFOLLOWABLE` and its row from `_EXPECTED_RUN_REQUEST_SITES`, decrementing the frozen AST-derived RunRequest count from 27 to 26; add no replacement RunRequest row, because the live coach LLM call is the YAML `plan-review-coach` prompt step whose request is already exercised through `workflow/runs.py::build_agent_request`. Re-express the bare-string, fail-closed guard oracle through `_guard_scoped` or the interpreter execution path, preserving its `False` behavior. Preserve semantic behavior, then delete both superseded helpers and stale maintained prose/comments/string literals naming them as live owners.

## Scope

- `src/rebar/llm/plan_review/passes.py` — remove `pass4_coach` only after migration.
- `src/rebar/llm/workflow/executor.py` — remove `_guard_passes` only after migration.
- `src/rebar/llm/workflow/interpreter.py`, `src/rebar/llm/review_kernel/coach.py`, and `src/rebar/llm/workflow/gates/plan-review.yaml` — retain and test the canonical ownership/behavior.
- `src/rebar/llm/plan_review/workflow_ops.py`, `src/rebar/llm/plan_review/coach_moves.py`, `src/rebar/llm/plan_review/orchestrator.py`, and `src/rebar/schemas/plan_review_coach_inputs_output.schema.json` — update maintained string literals/comments describing the live coach owner.
- `tests/unit/test_plan_review.py` — migrate the direct behavioral `pass4_coach` callers.
- `tests/unit/test_subcall_class_selection.py` — remove the stale `pass4_coach` entries from `_UNFOLLOWABLE` and `_EXPECTED_RUN_REQUEST_SITES`, and update the derived inventory count.
- `tests/unit/workflow/test_plan_review_workflow.py` and `tests/unit/workflow/test_prior_art_hardening.py` — preserve workflow coach behavior and move the fail-closed guard oracle.
- maintained documentation/comments only where they assert the removed helper remains live.

## Testing

Run `pytest tests/unit/test_plan_review.py tests/unit/test_subcall_class_selection.py tests/unit/workflow/test_plan_review_workflow.py tests/unit/workflow/test_prior_art_hardening.py`, then the relevant plan-review/workflow suite. Include a no-surviving-findings control proving no coach LLM call, a rendering/model-selection control, a derived-inventory equality control with count `26`, and a bare-string guard control proving fail-closed behavior through the live scoped/interpreter path.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] `pass4_coach` and `_guard_passes` are deleted only after their behavioral tests have migrated to the canonical workflow/shared coach and `_guard_scoped` or interpreter behavior.
- [x] `tests/unit/test_subcall_class_selection.py` contains no stale `pass4_coach` entries in `_UNFOLLOWABLE` or `_EXPECTED_RUN_REQUEST_SITES`, and the AST-derived RunRequest inventory count is `26`.
- [x] The migrated coach tests prove applicability, decision inclusion, deterministic rendering, and model selection through the canonical workflow/shared coach owner.
- [x] A clean-plan control proves the canonical coach path makes no LLM call when no findings survive.
- [x] The migrated guard oracle sends a bare-string guard through the live scoped/interpreter path and asserts it fails closed.
- [x] `pytest tests/unit/test_plan_review.py tests/unit/test_subcall_class_selection.py tests/unit/workflow/test_plan_review_workflow.py tests/unit/workflow/test_prior_art_hardening.py` and the focused workflow/plan-review suite pass.
